At this early stage, the third quarter earnings season for the S&P 500 has seen a mixed start relative to expectations. While the percentage of S&P 500 companies reporting positive earnings surprises is above recent averages, the magnitude of earnings surprises is below recent averages. As a result of this mixed performance and downward revisions to EPS estimates for companies in the Health Care sector, the index is reporting lower earnings for the third quarter today relative to the end of last week and relative to the end of the quarter. Despite the decrease in earnings, the index is still reporting (year-over-year) earnings growth above 25% for the 3rd straight quarter.

Wyoming’s pitch to hyperscale tech developers has long rested on low-cost industrial power, available rural land, and an agreeable business climate. But as developers announce pipelines exceeding 5 GW of planned hyperscale capacity across the state, which includes multi-gigawatt campuses in Cheyenne, Evanston, and Casper, state regulatory dockets, not site-selection brochures, are defining the economics of deployment. With the Wyoming Public Service Commission (WPSC) reviewing 2026 general rate filings from PacifiCorp d/b/a Rocky Mountain Power (Docket No. 20000-710-ER-26) and Black Hills Power (Docket No. 20002-148-ER-26), the central issue has shifted from site acquisition to cost assignment: who pays for regional generation, high-voltage transmission interconnects, and local substation expansions, and how fast will those expenditures enter the retail rate base?

Portfolio construction is entering a new phase. Over the past several decades, much of the innovation in portfolio construction has focused on the mathematics: richer objectives, more realistic measures of risk, increasingly sophisticated constraints, transaction costs, taxes, multi-asset class portfolios, and multi-period investment decisions. Those advances have made the underlying machinery much more powerful.

pages.raw_meta: Discover FactSet Portfolio Analytics to maximize portfolio efficiency and simplify investment decisions. Gain customized insights and robust analytics for improved outcomes.
raw_blocks: FactSet's portfolio analytics solutions help scale your firm's operations with easier data integration, reconciliation, and standardization. We track your data workflows and provide pre- and post-calculation checks, including workflow monitoring, file consistency checks, integration checks, multi-asset class coverage checks, and fixed-income analytics.
Know your portfolio, reduce your risk

Streamline daily processes and adapt quickly to market shifts using FactSet’s customizable platform. Quickly analyze exposures, risk , benchmark-relative metrics, and performance across multi-asset class portfolios, including fixed income and private markets . Use scenario analysis and stress testing to keep your portfolio resilient under changing conditions. Choose from pre-built reports or create custom views to fit your firm’s needs.
Align attribution to drive smarter decisions

Understand what drives your portfolio’s performance and risk by leveraging FactSet’s 10+ attribution models, such as Fixed Income Attribution and Investment Process Attribution. Deliver clear, tailored insights aligned to portfolio objectives. From country or sector allocation to managing yield curve positioning and spreads, we provide accurate, actionable insights. Plus, with our generative AI, you can automate the creation of detailed, source-linked portfolio commentary , freeing up your time and energy for more impactful tasks.
Bridge silos with connected data across teams

Easily send portfolio analytics across your organization and to clients with tools built for seamless collaboration. Whether you need a fully-managed reporting solution or ready-to-use data for your existing systems, we make it simple. Our platform offers user-friendly interfaces and robust APIs to meet your business needs. Working with data ecosystems like Snowflake or Databricks? Our APIs and integrations ensure smooth, efficient workflows. Prefer a third party to manage board or client reporting? Our pixel-perfect reports deliver consistency and professionalism every time.
See how whole portfolio analysis improves your understanding of performance, exposures, risk, and attribution across your portfolio assets—all in one place.
Best Platform for Risk and Portfolio Analytics
Best Data Platform for Risk & Portfolio Analytics

FactSet Portfolio Analytics is a customizable, award-winning platform that helps investment professionals analyze portfolios with confidence. It brings together performance measurement, risk analysis, exposure monitoring, and attribution in a single, integrated system. This allows teams to streamline daily processes, adapt to market shifts, and deliver clear insights to stakeholders.

FactSet Portfolio Analytics supports multi-asset class portfolios, including fixed income and private markets assets. The platform provides comprehensive coverage with built-in analytics checks, classifications, and returns validation to ensure data quality throughout your workflows.

FactSet offers 10+ attribution models to help you understand what drives portfolio performance and risk. The platform supports analysis across country and sector allocation, yield curve positioning, and spreads. It also leverages generative AI to automate the creation of detailed, source-linked portfolio commentary, reducing manual effort and freeing time for higher-value work.

Analyze exposures, risk, benchmark-relative metrics, and performance across multi-asset class portfolios
Conduct scenario analysis and stress testing to keep portfolios resilient under changing conditions
Choose from pre-built reports or create fully custom views to fit your firm's needs
